vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
If by “get ChatGPT to name my company” you mean an agency or consultant who can make your company appear when U.S. users ask things like “What are the best companies for X?”, there is no person or firm that can guarantee that organic placement.

OpenAI says ChatGPT Search can surface any public website, and its shopping recommendations are selected independently rather than being paid placements. ([help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12627856-publishers-and-developers-faq%23%3A~%3Atext%3DChatGPT%2520automatically%2520includes%2520the%2520UTM%2520parameter%2520utm_source%253Dchatgpt.com%2520in%2520referral%2520URLs%252C%2520enabling%2520clear%2520tracking%2520and%2520analysis%2520of%2520inbound%2520traffic%2520from%2520ChatGPT%2520search%2520results?utm_source=openai))

There are, however, people you can hire to improve your chances. The emerging service is usually called “GEO” (generative engine optimization), “AI search optimization,” “LLM optimization,” or sometimes “AEO.” A good provider would work on your site's crawlability, authoritative third-party mentions, structured/product data, and the information ChatGPT can retrieve about your company. OpenAI specifically recommends allowing OAI-SearchBot so content can be discovered and surfaced in ChatGPT Search. ([help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12627856-publishers-and-developers-faq%23%3A~%3Atext%3DChatGPT%2520automatically%2520includes%2520the%2520UTM%2520parameter%2520utm_source%253Dchatgpt.com%2520in%2520referral%2520URLs%252C%2520enabling%2520clear%2520tracking%2520and%2520analysis%2520of%2520inbound%2520traffic%2520from%2520ChatGPT%2520search%2520results?utm_source=openai))

If your company sells products, there's an even more direct route: OpenAI now accepts structured product feeds through its Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), specifically to help ChatGPT index and surface products. Shopify merchants already have product data integrated through Shopify Catalog. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/powering-product-discovery-in-chatgpt/?utm_source=openai))

If you give me your company name, website, and what you want ChatGPT to recommend you for, I can research the U.S. firms that specialize in this and identify 3–5 credible options rather than generic SEO agencies.
